opening.argument: The presentation solicits viewers to deploy and fund a trading contract, expressly stating that “we're going to need to fund our contract with BNB” to snipe liquidity pools. It claims the mechanism will automatically return 90% of profits to the viewer’s wallet and presents an initial contribution of 0.5 BNB, while asserting weekly earnings of 7 to 8 BNB. The description further states that, after deployment, the bot will send funds to a migrator address. These instructions and unusually large claimed returns establish a direct financial solicitation tied to automated trading-contract activity. Although the speaker says participation is “at your own risk,” and the record does not independently establish that the claimed returns occurred or that funds were lost, that disclaimer does not remove the solicitation or its promised-return framing.
